blocks.text: The HyperX Cloud III is an evolution of our legendary Cloud II, which is known for its comfort, sound quality and durability. With plush HyperX signature memory foam in the headband and ear cushions, it provides a comfortable fit perfect for long gaming sessions. It also features new, retuned 53mm drivers that are angled for an optimal listening experience. The upgraded 10mm microphone captures crystal clear in-game voice chat and calls. Simple controls on the headset earcup allow you to have quick, direct access to mute your mic or adjust audio volume. The LED mic mute clearly shows when you’re muted. Compatible with PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, Mac, and Mobile. Experience ultimate comfort and sound across your favorite platforms.

items.label: Comfort is King
items.value: Comfort’s in the Cloud III’s DNA. Built for gamers who can’t have an uncomfortable headset ruin the flow of their full-combo, disrupt their speedrun, or knocking them out of the zone.

items.label: Audio Tuned for Your Entertainment
items.value: Angled 53mm drivers have been tuned by HyperX audio engineers to provide the optimal listening experience that accents the dynamic sounds of gaming.

items.label: Upgraded Microphone for Clarity and Accuracy
items.value: Captures high-quality audio for clear voice chat and calls. The mic is noise-cancelling and features a built-in mesh filter to omit disruptive sounds and LED mic mute indicator lets you know when you’re muted.

items.label: Durability, for the Toughest of Battles
items.value: The headset is flexible and features an aluminum frame so it’s resilient against travel, accidents, mishaps, and your ‘level-headed’ reactions to losses and defeat screens.

items.label: DTS Headphone
items.value: X Spatial Audio: A lifetime activation of DTS Spatial Audio will help amp up your audio advantage and immersion with its precise sound localization and virtual 3D sound stage.

items.label: Built-In Media
items.value: Detachable microphone, Headphone, USB to 3.5mm cable, USB-C Adapter
